description: Reads the mark state of objects of a local session as {session:{index, name, path}, objects:[{handle, type, name, isMarkable, markState, isUpToDate, isMarkedByMe, isMarkedByOthers}]}. markState is the flags text (for example "IsUptoDate, IsMarkedByMe") and the three booleans are its flags; an object with isMarkable:false cannot be marked. Object handles (positive integers) come from the `handle` fields of tia_local_sessions and tia_markings or from the tia_obj_* tools on the session's project; they die with the session. Missing handles is 400 missing_param, malformed or more than 200 is 400 bad_request, an unresolvable handle is 404 not_found. `session` is the name or the full path of an open local session (as listed by tia_local_sessions; the project path first, then the project name ignoring case) and may be left out when exactly one session is open: none open is 409 no_local_session, several open without `session` (or a selector that matches several) is 409 ambiguous_session (details.sessions lists index, name and path), an unknown one is 404 not_found. Needs a running TIA Portal on the serve host (tia_start) but no open project. Maps to GET /multiuser/localsessions/markstate?session=&handles=1,2,3. Read-only (class R).

handles.description: 1 to 200 object handles (positive integers) of objects of the local session

session.description: name or full path of the open local session (from tia_local_sessions); optional when exactly one session is open

name: tia_mark_state
title: TIA — mark state of objects
